memberships.page_title: Filtered Regular Nilpotent Pencils in Dimension Five

statement: In the five-dimensional square-zero two-matrix ansatz with a coordinate collision, exactly three active rows, one directed support edge in each active row, and all five vertices used by the three edges, the Keller equations have no solution.
title: Three-Row Sparse Exclusion in Dimension Five
